title: Arithmetic that cannot overflow silently
hints: For addition with positive `b`, overflow happens exactly when `a > max - b`; with negative `b`, when `a < min - b`. Those subtractions themselves cannot overflow.
For unsigned multiplication, `a * b` exceeds the maximum exactly when `b > max / a` (for `a` not 0).
rules: Check the limits before the operation, without wider types or compiler built-ins.
